response.justification: Bogdan possesses strong senior-level engineering experience with a notable background in geospatial data platforms and high-performance distributed systems. However, his recent technology stack leans heavily toward TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, lacking recent professional experience in modern C++ or Rust, which are the primary requirements for this role. His domain knowledge makes him an interesting candidate if he is willing and able to ramp up quickly on C++ or Rust.
strengths: Extensive domain knowledge in geospatial data processing and mapping platforms.
Proven experience building high-performance, low-latency distributed systems and microservices.
Strong engineering practices, including TDD, CI/CD, and open-source tool development.
concerns: Lacks recent professional experience in modern C++ or Rust (C/C++ experience dates back to 2014-2015).
Recent roles have heavily focused on full-stack web technologies rather than systems programming.
No direct mention of building specific routing pipelines or navigation guidance solutions.
